Study notes · 26_rewired_p0.1index
1125.5 ms (jones) / 817.8 ms (transport) · 1.0 ions per transport instruction · up to 2 waveforms a cycle, no select bits, shims 0.2 ms at 1:1 / 3.6 ms at 1:16 · R10: Lean checker + tableau
28 random swaps take the torus from diameter 12 to 8, and under one waveform a cycle the shorter distances do not pay: the round goes from 516.4 to 1,125.5 ms, one ion per transport instruction. Not drawable: every shortcut would be crossings on a chip. It runs under the one-waveform model (control.model simd_classes: one motion a cycle, the R22 split) on direct wiring, so its time is an upper bound for a direct machine. Before the R22 split it was 82 ms.
